literal_meaning: পোষাক (dress/clothes) এবং আশাক (adornments/attire) এর সমন্বয়; নানাবিধ পোশাক-পরিচ্ছদ
figurative_meaning_en: A pleonastic compound word denoting various types of clothing and attires in plural sense
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমি বাজার থেকে নতুন পোষাক-আশাক কিনে এনেছি।
বিয়ের অনুষ্ঠানে সবাই সুন্দর পোষাক-আশাক পরে এসেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: I bought new clothes and attires from the market.
Everyone came dressed in beautiful clothes and outfits for the wedding ceremony.
note: This expression is a common Bengali way to refer to diverse clothing items, emphasizing variety through redundancy.
